faq.title: Your questions, answered plainly
faq.intro: The questions we get before every project, and our answers.

items.q: What types of projects do you take on?
items.a: We deliver digital projects of every size: websites, web applications, mobile apps, SaaS platforms, e-commerce, integrations, automations and custom solutions. We can handle a relatively simple project just as well as the development of a far more complex digital product.

items.q: What types of businesses do you work with?
items.a: We can work with practically any type of organization: SMEs, startups, industrial companies, large enterprises, institutions, non-profits, agencies and technology companies. Our approach adapts to the project, the size of the organization and its technical needs.

items.q: What technology stack do you use?
items.a: Our stack varies with the needs of the project. We choose technologies based on the constraints, the performance required, scalability and long-term maintenance.

items.q: How does your work process unfold?
items.a: Our process generally follows 7 main steps: Discovery → Project scoping → Architecture & planning → UX/UI design → Development → Testing & adjustments → Deployment & evolution. The goal is to support the client from the idea through to production, then keep evolving the solution as needed.

items.q: Do you work in French and in English?
items.a: Yes. Talgasy Web works in French and in English, for client communications as well as for documentation, design and project delivery.

items.q: Do you build custom forms for websites?
items.a: Yes. We can build forms tailored precisely to the company’s process: custom fields, conditional logic, data validation, quote requests, document collection, lead qualification and integration with CRMs or other systems. The form is built around the client’s real workflow rather than from a generic template.

Talgasy Web is based in Québec, Canada, but our development model is international. We collaborate with professionals in different markets to select the skills best suited to each project. Our goal is to bring together the right expertise, without limiting the team to a single region.

meta.title: About Talgasy Web — Your development partner, from idea to launch
meta.description: Talgasy Web helps Canadian businesses turn their ideas into concrete digital solutions: websites, applications, SaaS, automation. Quality, professionalism, trust.

hero.title: About
hero.lede: Talgasy Web was born from a simple idea: making development more accessible to businesses.
hero.mapAria: Dotted world map showing our base in Québec, Canada

story.quote: Talgasy Web was created to help Canadian businesses turn their ideas into concrete digital solutions, without making the development process needlessly complex.
paragraphs: Our role is to simplify development for our clients: understand the need, structure the project, choose the right technologies and build the solution with them.

Whether it is a website, a web application, a mobile application, a SaaS platform, an automation or a custom system, our goal stays the same: make development clearer, more structured and easier to manage for the business.
Talgasy Web acts as a development partner, from the idea all the way to launch.

items.title: Understand before building
items.body: We don’t start by coding. We start by understanding your business, your users, your goals and the problem to solve. That lets us build a solution that meets a real need, rather than piling on features with no direction.

items.title: Build the right solution
items.body: Every project is different. We choose the technologies, the architecture and the development method based on the project, its complexity and how it will evolve. Website, application, SaaS, automation or custom system: the technology must serve the project, not the other way around.

items.title: Support you over time
items.body: Our work doesn’t necessarily end at launch. We can keep maintaining, improving and evolving your solution as your business grows and your needs change.

principles.title: Principles
principles.intro: Talgasy Web rests on a simple idea: a website should bring you customers, not just look good.

items.title: Quality
items.body: We make no compromise on quality. Every detail is refined to deliver a professional, credible result worthy of your business.

items.title: Professionalism
items.body: We work with seriousness, rigour and transparency at every step. From the first conversation to delivery, you can count on a professional, reliable team committed to your project’s success.

items.title: Trust
items.body: Honest conversations, commitments kept, and clear follow-up from start to finish.

positioning.title: From simple projects to enterprise platforms
paragraphs: Talgasy Web designs and builds custom digital solutions for organizations of every size. SME, startup, industrial company, institution, non-profit, agency or large enterprise: our team adapts to the context, the goals and the complexity of the project.
From websites to business applications, through mobile apps, SaaS platforms, internal systems and automations, we step in wherever development can create value.

faq.title: Your questions, answered plainly
faq.intro: Do you have questions before starting your project?

items.a: Every project is different. We start with a consultation to pin down your needs, then offer you a clear price. A website starts at $1,500, a logo at $600 and hosting at $35 per month. All services are detailed on this page.

items.q: How long does it take to build a site?
items.a: For simple projects, count 3 to 5 days, especially if your photos and texts are ready. More complex projects can take a few weeks.

items.q: I have neither texts nor photos.
items.a: No problem, that is the most common situation. We help you with the texts, and we find or create the photos that fit.

items.q: I already have a site, but it is weak. Do you rebuild it?
items.a: Yes, a redesign is entirely possible. We start with a consultation to analyze your current site, then support you through the whole redesign process.

items.q: Will the site be in French and in English?
items.a: Yes, all our sites are bilingual by default, so you can reach your whole clientele, whatever their language.

items.q: How will my clients reach me or book an appointment?
items.a: They have several simple ways to reach you: a request directly on the site, an email, a call, or even a message on social media. From there, you schedule the consultation with them, however suits you.

items.q: Will I be able to manage my blog myself?
items.a: Yes, you are free to manage your blog yourself. And if you lack the time or do not feel like handling it, we can take care of it for you.

items.q: Will the site rank well on Google?
items.a: We structure every site according to SEO best practices — speed, mobile and local content — to optimize its Google ranking. Google controls the final ranking, but we put every chance on your side with solid foundations to maximize your visibility and your results.
